description: This file implements a fact-checking service with functions to process claims, fetch and analyze sources, score the credibility of sources, and update claim statuses in a database. It orchestrates the fact-check pipeline asynchronously, including database interactions and WebSocket broadcasting.

classes.name: AnalysisSummary
classes.description: Schema representing the summary of a fact-checking analysis, including claim ID, textual summary, and score.

classes.name: SourceItem
classes.description: Schema representing a source item used for fact-checking, containing source details, reliability score, and stance.

methods.name: None _update_claim(claim_id: str, updates: dict, event_type: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates a claim document with specified fields and optionally sends a WebSocket event.

methods.name: float _score_sources(sources: List[SourceItem])
methods.description: Calculates a heuristic score for a list of source items, considering reliability and stance.

methods.name: None process_claim(claim_id: str)
methods.description: Main orchestrator function to run the fact-checking pipeline for a given claim ID, including fetching sources, analyzing, scoring, and updating statuses.

ctags.name: _update_claim
ctags.pattern: /^async def _update_claim(claim_id: str, updates: dict, event_type: Optional[str] = None) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (claim_id: str, updates: dict, event_type: Optional[str] = None)
